metaDesc.en: Branding and web design for Clínica Mar Atlântico, an integrative mental-health clinic. Case study by Bruno Reis.

lead.en: Clínica Mar Atlântico is an online-first mental-health clinic offering psychiatry, psychology, and nutrition under one standard: clinical excellence delivered with real humanity, support for every phase of life. Mental-health care often forces a false choice between authority and warmth, a clinic feeling either rigorous or welcoming but rarely both. Mar Atlântico needed an identity that held the two together: the seriousness of expert medicine and the feeling of being genuinely heard, without judgment. So we anchored the brand in its own name (the Atlantic), using the ocean as a language for depth, calm, and steady support.

goals.en: Build an identity that signals medical excellence and human warmth at once, so neither undercuts the other. Give an online-first clinic a presence patients trust before the first appointment, coherent from the landing page to the consultation.

result.en: A complete identity that turns the Atlantic into a system. The symbol layers concentric arcs (ripples on water, and also the sense of being heard) around a central eye-and-leaf form, reading at once as a wave, a horizon, and a vessel. Set in deep Atlantic navy with a light-sky accent and a rounded, humanist wordmark, it carries authority and warmth in the same breath. The language scales from website and social to out-of-home, with portraits masked inside the brand's own wave shapes, giving a distributed online practice a calm, grounded presence patients recognize on sight.
